title: web: map view + rally point (send troops) view
criteria:
Write the map and rally views. Follow the VIEW CONTRACT already used by app.js/village.js: `export async function render(el, ctx, params)`; params = { id, vid, query (URLSearchParams) }; ctx = { meta, state, village (VillageView of the current village), villageId, toast(msg, isError), refresh(), navigate(hash) }. Build DOM ONLY with h()/clear() from ../dom.js (never innerHTML). The API client is `api` from ../api.js (paths relative to /api).

== web/js/views/map.js (route #/map?x=&y=) ==
Center = query x,y (integers) or the current village's coordinates (ctx.village.village.x/y). Fetch `api.get('/map?cx=' + cx + '&cy=' + cy + '&r=7')` (MapView: {size, center, radius, tiles:[{x,y,kind,layout,oasis_type,village|null}]}, tiles ordered by y then x, 15x15). Draw on a <canvas> with the 2D context: a 15x15 grid of 40px cells (canvas width/height 600, CSS width 100% with max-width 600px and height auto, so it shrinks on phones; convert pointer coordinates with the canvas bounding box). Tile colors: valley #cfe3b4, oasis #7fbf6a, mountain #a08c74, lake #7fb2d9; thin grid lines; a village is drawn as a filled circle: blue #1f5fbf when village.is_mine, red #c0392b when village.is_bot and not mine; the cell of the current center gets a darker outline. Dragging with the pointer (pointerdown/move/up) pans: when released, convert the drag distance into whole tiles (dx tiles = round(-deltaX / cellPixelSize)) and navigate with ctx.navigate('#/map?x=' + newX + '&y=' + newY) (wrap not needed: the server wraps). Controls above the canvas: four arrow buttons (← ↑ ↓ →) moving the center by 3 tiles, two number inputs for x and y prefilled with the center and a button 'ไป' that navigates to the typed coordinates. Clicking a cell (a click = pointer up with less than 5 px movement) selects it and fills an info `.panel` below the canvas: line 'พิกัด (x, y)' and the tile type label (valley 'หุบเขา', oasis 'โอเอซิส', mountain 'ภูเขา', lake 'ทะเลสาบ'); when a village stands there: its name, 'ผู้เล่น: <player_name>', 'เผ่า: <tribe name_th from ctx.meta.tribes>', 'ประชากร: <population>', and a marker line 'ของคุณ' when is_mine or 'bot' when is_bot; when the tile is empty of villages show 'ไม่มีหมู่บ้าน'. The panel always has a primary button 'ส่งทัพ' that navigates to '#/rally/' + ctx.villageId + '?x=' + x + '&y=' + y (hidden when the selected tile is the player's own village). Show a heading 'แผนที่'.

== web/js/views/rally.js (route #/rally/:vid?x=&y=) ==
Uses ctx.village (the village of :vid). Heading 'ส่งทัพ'. Form: for every unit in ctx.village.troops_home with count > 0 a row '<name_th from ctx.meta.units> (มี <count>)' with a number input (min 0, max count, default 0) and a small button 'ทั้งหมด' that fills the max; a mission <select> with the options attack 'โจมตี', raid 'ปล้น', scout 'สอดแนม', reinforce 'ส่งทัพเสริม' (no settle); two number inputs for the target x and y prefilled from the query (or empty); when any selected unit is 'catapult' and the mission is attack, an extra <select> 'เป้าเครื่องยิงหิน' with a first option 'สุ่ม' (value '') followed by one option per building in ctx.meta.buildings whose kind is 'center' (name_th). A result `.panel` that shows the preview: after every change of any field (debounced 300 ms) POST `api.post('/villages/' + vid + '/send/preview', {to_x, to_y, mission, units:{unit: count > 0 only}, catapult_target: value or null})` (skip when no unit is selected or x/y empty) and show 'เวลาถึง: <fmtTime(arrive_at)>', 'ใช้เวลา: <fmtDuration(travel_time_s)>', 'ระยะทาง: <distance rounded to 1 decimal>', 'บรรทุกได้: <fmtNum(carry)>' and every entry of `errors` as a `.negative` line. A primary button 'ส่ง' disabled when there is no unit selected, x/y are empty, or the last preview had errors; clicking POSTs `/villages/' + vid + '/send` with the same body, then ctx.toast('ส่งทัพแล้ว') and `await ctx.refresh()`; ApiError -> ctx.toast(err.message, true). Show 'ไม่มีทหารให้ส่ง' instead of the unit rows when there are none. Below the form: a `.panel` 'ทัพเสริมในหมู่บ้านนี้' listing ctx.village.reinforcements_here as rows '<from_village.name>: <units as name x count, ...>' with a button 'เรียกกลับ' which POSTs `/troops/<id>/recall` for every id of troop_ids one after another, then ctx.toast('เรียกทัพกลับแล้ว') and ctx.refresh() (list shows 'ไม่มีทัพเสริม' when empty); and a `.panel` 'ทัพ' with ctx.village.movements as in views/village.js (arrow + mission label + target (x, y) + units + `<span class="countdown" data-countdown=ISO>`, hostile rows use class negative; 'ไม่มีทัพเคลื่อนที่' when empty). Mission labels for those rows: attack 'โจมตี', raid 'ปล้น', scout 'สอดแนม', reinforce 'ส่งทัพเสริม', settle 'ตั้งหมู่บ้านใหม่', return 'กลับบ้าน'.

== web/css/style.css ==
APPEND a new section '/* map + rally */' at the END (canvas styling, map controls row, unit rows, form rows). Do not modify existing rules.
notes:
- Thai strings: use ONLY the strings written in single quotes in this task (copy them letter by letter; they were proofread; the common mistakes to avoid are 'บ่าน' for 'บ้าน', 'ท่ี' for 'ที่', 'น้ี' for 'นี้', doubled tone marks). Do not type any other Thai.
- Imports: `import { h, clear } from '../dom.js'; import { api, ApiError } from '../api.js'; import { fmtNum, fmtDuration, fmtTime } from '../format.js'; import { countdown } from '../clock.js';`
- Use `ctx.village.village.x/y` for the village's own coordinates (VillageView.village is a VillageBrief).
- The app already skips re-rendering while the user types in an input inside #view.
- Debounce with setTimeout/clearTimeout; return a cleanup function from render that clears pending timers and removes window-level listeners you added.
- Run the test_cmd (node --check on every js file) and fix syntax errors.
